appraisal.title: Mobile Appraisal Application
appraisal.description: Hybrid mobile solution enabling offline completion of dynamic forms using Formly. Designed for field appraisers to work seamlessly without internet connectivity.
appraisal.highlights: Offline-first architecture, Dynamic form generation, Data synchronization
appraisal.privacyNote: Note: Images shown are illustrative only, as this is a private project and confidential information cannot be disclosed.

faceAntiSpoofing.title: Face Anti-Spoofing System
faceAntiSpoofing.description: AI-powered solution to prevent identity falsification by detecting presentation attacks in facial recognition systems.
faceAntiSpoofing.highlights: Real-time detection, High accuracy rate, Lightweight model

stateDetection.title: Optimized State Detection Model
stateDetection.description: Machine learning model optimized to achieve high accuracy with minimal training data, demonstrating efficient use of limited datasets.
stateDetection.highlights: Small dataset optimization, High precision, Fast inference

vectorDB.title: Facial Recognition System with Weaviate and TensorFlow
vectorDB.description: This project implements a facial recognition system using Weaviate, a vector database, to store facial embeddings, and TensorFlow for face detection and recognition. It includes a graphical user interface for user registration and identification in images and video.
vectorDB.highlights: Weaviate - Vector database, TensorFlow - Machine learning

iFixIt.title: iFixIt - Workshop Management Platform
iFixIt.description: Comprehensive web and mobile platform for automotive workshop management, featuring real-time location tracking, appointment scheduling, and service management.
iFixIt.highlights: Full-stack solution, Real-time tracking, Mobile & Web interfaces

puraCompra.title: Pura Compra - E-commerce Intermediary
puraCompra.description: Platform connecting users with multiple online stores, providing a unified shopping experience with price comparisons and streamlined checkout.
puraCompra.highlights: Multi-store integration, Price comparison, Unified checkout
